title.zh: Blockchain.com申请美国监管牌照，拟推出预测市场与加密衍生品交易
title.en: Blockchain.com申请美国监管牌照，拟推出预测市场与加密衍生品交易

current_state.zh: Blockchain.com has filed with the CFTC for designated contract market and futures commission merchant licenses to offer event contracts and crypto derivatives to US retail and institutional clients, extending its prediction-market and perpetuals business into the regulated US market while it pursues an IPO.
current_state.en: Blockchain.com has filed with the CFTC for designated contract market and futures commission merchant licenses to offer event contracts and crypto derivatives to US retail and institutional clients, extending its prediction-market and perpetuals business into the regulated US market while it pursues an IPO.
